name: No Stop Requested
source:
Play as Stephanie, an average student, who takes a mysterious bus with her friends and winds up in an alternate dimension! In order to make it back home, she'll have to brave many strange (and sometimes deadly!) things that lurk around every corner.

[From [url=https://kapeepa.itch.io/no-stop-requested]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演斯蒂芬妮，一名普通学生，与朋友们乘坐神秘巴士，最终来到了另一个维度！为了回家，她必须勇敢地面对潜伏在每个角落的许多奇怪的（有时甚至是致命的！）事物。

[来自[url=https://kapeepa.itch.io/no-stop-requested]Itch.io[/url]]
